Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA

6:00
p.m.

505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 21, 2019 Special-Closed Session Meeting, August 21, 2019 Regular Meeting, and August 28, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-09-11 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Adoption of Ordinance 2019-11 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12.060.C Conflict of Interest Code. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance 2019-11 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12.060.C regarding Conflict of Interest filers."
2019-09-11 Item 08B Conflict of Interest Code Amendment
8C.
Proposed Amendments to City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Staff recommends that City Council approve the proposed amendments to City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management that includes an expanded policy statement, expanded definitions, incorporated information from the Integrated Pest Management Plan G009, and allows a special use category for all pesticides.
2019-09-11 Item 08C Proposed Amendments to City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management
8D.
Construction Contract for the Senior Center ADA Improvements Project (CF18A). Contact Person: Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager, to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with L.C. Paving and Sealing Inc. in the amount of $186,423 plus 15 percent contingency of $27,964, for a total contract amount not to exceed $214,387 to construct the Senior Center ADA Improvements Project.
2019-09-11 Item 08D Senior Center ADA Improvements Construction Contract
8E.
Notice of Completion for the Bonita Drive Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS19C). Contact Person: Engineer Widelski
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion
2019-09-11 Item 08E Bonita Drive Sidewalk Improvements Notice of Completion
8F.
Proposed 2019-2020 Environmental Commission Work Plan. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Receive the 2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan outcomes overview; and 2) Approve the Proposed 2019-2020 Environmental Commission Work Plan.
2019-09-11 Item 08F Environmental Commission Work Plan 2019-2020
8G.
Second Reading and Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-10 to move the requirements for Lot Consolidations from Chapter 24.60 (Minor Subdivisions – Tentative Parcel Map) to Chapter 24.70 (Lot Line Adjustments). Title 24 of the Municipal Code is a component of the Local Coastal Program (LCP); therefore, the LCP would also be amended as part of this application. Contact Person: Principal Planner Yentile
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-10 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Chapters 24.60 (Minor Subdivisions – Tentative Parcel Map) and 24.70 (Subdivisions) of the Encinitas Municipal Code.”
2019-09-11 Item 08G Second Reading and Adoption - Lot Consolidations
8H.
SANDAG Grant: Census 2020 Complete Count. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
1) Ratify the application for grant funds submitted by staff on August 26, 2019 to the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG); 2) Authority the City Manager to execute a Grant Agreement once the City has been approved to receive funds; and 3) Approve the Budget Adjustment Resolution contingent upon award of the Census 2020 Complete Count Grant Funds.
2019-09-11 Item 08H Census 2020 Complete Count Grant
08I.
Contract Amendments for As-Needed Civil Engineering and Project Management. Contact Person: Civil Engineer Wimmer
1) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the STC Traffic, Inc. (STC) agreement for as-needed civil engineering services, in an amount of $300,000, for a total contract not exceeding $750,000 and extend the term to December 31, 2020; 2) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the Hoch Consulting agreement for as-needed project management services, in an additional amount of $150,000, for a total contract not exceeding$1,113,500; 3) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the Latitude 33 Planning and Engineering (Latitude 33) agreement for as-needed civil engineering services, in an additional amount of $140,000, for a total contract not exceeding $590,000 and extend the term to December 31, 2020; 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-73, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” (Attachment 4) allocating $140,000; and 5) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to the Dokken, Dudek, Nasland, and NV5 agreements for as-needed civil engineering agreements to extend the terms to December 31, 2020.
2019-09-11 Item 08I As Needed Civil Engineering Contract Amendments

Establish vehicle length and width limits on South Coast Highway 101 (adjacent to Cardiff State Beach), Moonlight Beach, Swami's Beach, Grandview Beach, and Beacon's Beach Parking Lots Between the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski and Director of Parks, Recreation & Cultural Arts Campbell
Introduce Ordinance No. 2019-17 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Vehicle Length and Width Limits on South Coast Highway 101 (adjacent to Cardiff State Beach), Moonlight Beach, Swami's Beach, Grandview Beach, and Beacon's Beach Parking Lots Between Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day."

Execution of the San Diego Regional Community Choice Energy Authority (SDRCCEA) Joint Powers Agreement, formation of a Community Choice Energy Program, and appointment of two City Council Members to the SDRCCEA Board of Directors. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-80 titled, "A resolution of the City Council of Encinitas approving and authorizing the execution of the joint exercise of powers agreement creating the San Diego Regional Community Choice Energy Authority;" 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the SDRCCEA Joint Powers Agreement (JPA) between the cities of Encinitas, San Diego, Chula Vista, La Mesa, and any other participating cities, in substantial form; 3) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-18 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas authorizing the Implementation of a Community Choice Aggregation Program;" and 4) In accordance with the SDRCCEA JPA Section 4.2, appoint two Council Members as Primary and Alternate Directors to represent the interests of the City on the SDRCCEA JPA Board of Directors.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
